selection: Candidates: public laws of the 119th Congress whose OLRC classification rows include at least one non-note row, and for which OLRC publishes both the release point just before the law's classification and the one that first includes it (prior release points online on 2026-10-28 start at 119-73not60). Pick every candidate with at least 2 non-note rows, in public-law order; then fill to 20 with single-row candidates whose title is not yet covered, in public-law order. No candidate has another law in the same release-point window touching the same section. The plan asks for laws mostly in titles 49, 23 and 45; no available release point changes title 45, and title 49/23 text changes in this window come only from 119-60, so the corpus is spread across titles instead.
